data.name: Shariraj
data.gender_notes: Shariraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shariraj is derived from Sanskrit words 'Sharira' meaning body and 'Raj' meaning ruler or king. It signifies the one who rules over the body, representing the divine power that maintains and nourishes the physical form. The name Shariraj carries the meaning “God of Body” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shariraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god of body and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Shariraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Body.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shariraj total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name is also reflective of the Hindu belief in balancing the external and internal aspects of life, including the body and the soul.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Shariraj represents the deep connection between the physical body and the divine soul. It serves as a reminder that the body is a sacred vessel, and it is the soul that truly reigns supreme. The name inspires the awakening of the inner spiritual faculties and aims to lead the bearer towards self-realization and enlightenment.
